## Core Architectural & Engineering Competencies
- **Full Stack Web Applications**: High-performance Single Page Applications (SPA) built with Laravel, React 18, Inertia.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend Architecture & APIs**: RESTful API design, token & session security (Laravel Sanctum/JWT), microservices communication, webhooks, and rate-limiting.
- **Database Modeling & Query Optimization**: Relational database architecture (PostgreSQL, MySQL), indexing strategies, ERD normalization, Eloquent ORM tuning, and Redis caching layers.
- **System Administration & DevOps**: Production Linux server deployment (Debian/Ubuntu, Nginx, PHP-FPM 8.3, systemd services, SSL/TLS, UFW, fail2ban, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines).
- **Payment & Fintech Integration**: Escrow transaction engines, Mobile Money payment gateways (Orange Money, MTN MoMo Cameroon & CEMAC zone), Stripe, and automated billing reconciliation.
- **Interactive UI/UX & Creative Engineering**: Modern design systems with Blueprint architectural aesthetics, WebGL canvas shaders, Framer Motion transitions, responsive mobile-first layouts, and dark mode.
- **Generative AI & LLM Systems**: Integration of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini), RAG pipelines, intelligent bots (Telegram Bot Automation), and semantic search.

## Featured Real-World Projects
- [Sellify (E-Commerce & Escrow Marketplace)](https://mrdims.dev/projects/sellify): Comprehensive multi-vendor marketplace with secure Mobile Money escrow payments, vendor dashboard, automated delivery tracking, and dispute management.
- [Saamaya BI (Microfinance Financial Analytics)](https://mrdims.dev/projects/saamaya-bi): High-security business intelligence and regulatory compliance dashboard for microfinance institutions conforming to COBAC banking regulations.
- [Polyclinic ERP System](https://mrdims.dev/projects/polyclinic-erp): Medical hospital ERP digitizing patient electronic health records (EHR), multi-department pharmacy inventory, laboratory test queuing, and automated billing.
- [Telegram Automation Bot](https://mrdims.dev/projects/telegram-bot): Real-time server telemetry, alert dispatcher, and client lead-intake automation daemon powered by Python and systemd.
- [Architectural Portfolio Engine](https://mrdims.dev/projects/blueprint-portfolio): Custom portfolio platform featuring live server telemetry, interactive price estimators, multi-language switching (FR/EN), and high-performance WebGL animations.
